definitions.explanation: A secret plan by a group to do something harmful or illegal, especially against an authority or rival.

examples.japanese: {陰謀|いんぼう}を{企|たくら}む。
あの{事件|じけん}の{裏|うら}には{陰謀|いんぼう}があったと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that there was a conspiracy behind that incident.

examples.japanese: インターネットには{陰謀|いんぼう}{論|ろん}があふれているが、{根拠|こんきょ}のないものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The internet is full of conspiracy theories, but many of them have no basis.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{陰|いん} (shadow, hidden) + {謀|ぼう} (scheme, plot) = a hidden scheme.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {陰謀|いんぼう}{論|ろん}: conspiracy theory
- {陰謀|いんぼう}{論者|ろんじゃ}: conspiracy theorist

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陰謀|いんぼう}を{企|たくら}む: to plot a conspiracy
- {陰謀|いんぼう}を{暴|あば}く: to expose a conspiracy
- {陰謀|いんぼう}に{加担|かたん}する: to be party to a conspiracy
- {政治的|せいじてき}{陰謀|いんぼう}: political intrigue
